metadata.title: Chris Moore finds the end zone in Week 3
metadata.description: Chris Moore caught his lone target for a four-yard touchdown in a 34-31 win over the Cowboys in Week 3.
metadata.analysis: Moore made the most of his lone catch, hauling in a touchdown pass in the third quarter to give Baltimore a 23-13 lead. The veteran wideout has not been a featured weapon in the Baltimore passing attack this year, catching three passes for 63 yards and a touchdown through three games. He will now prepare to take on the Titans in Week 4.

metadata.title: Chris Moore - Good to go for Brazil
metadata.description: Moore (ankle) does not carry an injury designation into Sunday's game against the Cowboys.
metadata.analysis: Moore was limited in each of the first two practices of Week 3 prep due to an ankle injury, but he avoided an injury tag for Sunday's game in Rio de Janeiro, Brazil, after practicing in full Friday. The veteran wideout has two catches (on five targets) for 59 yards through two regular-season games, though his offensive snap count would take a hit if Zay Flowers (hamstring) was cleared to play against Dallas.

metadata.title: Chris Moore (ankle) active for Sunday
metadata.description: Chris Moore (ankle) will be active for Sunday's game against the Dallas Cowboys.
metadata.analysis: The Ravens have upgraded Moore to available to play for Sunday's game against the Cowboys. He won't be a relevant fantasy option either way but may see more work than usual if Zay Flowers (hamstring) is out for that matchup.

metadata.title: Chris Moore - Limited again Thursday
metadata.description: Moore (ankle) was limited during Thursday's practice.
metadata.analysis: Moore was limited for a second consecutive day, so he may be heading toward an injury designation for Sunday's meeting with Dallas. The wideout logged 32 snaps in the 24-17 loss to New Orleans in Week 2, second behind Rashod Bateman (54), though he ended the day with just one catch (three targets) for six yards. Zay Flowers (ankle) could be in line for another absence in Week 3, and if Moore joins him on the shelf against Dallas, LaJohntay Wester and Devontez Walker may need to be more involved alongside Bateman.

metadata.title: Chris Moore (ankle) limited again Thursday
metadata.description: Chris Moore (ankle) was limited at practice again on Thursday.
metadata.analysis: Baltimore is dealing with multiple injuries in their wide receiver room right now, including Moore, who has been limited at both practices so far this week due to an ankle injury. He seems more likely than not to play in Week 3, however, and would be in line for more work than usual if Zay Flowers (hamstring) is ruled out against the Cowboys.

metadata.title: Chris Moore - Limited with ankle issue
metadata.description: Moore (ankle) was a limited participant in Wednesday's practice.
metadata.analysis: Moore likely suffered the ankle injury in the Ravens' 24-17 loss to the Saints on Sunday. The wide receiver played 32 offensive snaps and eight special-teams snaps in the contest as the team's No. 4 option at wide receiver. If Moore cannot upgrade to a full practice participant by Friday's session, he will likely be stuck with an injury designation ahead of the Ravens' Week 3 matchup with the Cowboys.

metadata.title: Chris Moore is Limited During Wednesday's Practice
metadata.description: Baltimore Ravens wide receiver Chris Moore (ankle) was a limited participant in practice on Wednesday. It sounds like Moore suffered an ankle injury during Sunday's loss to the New Orleans Saints. Moore was expected to have a bigger role in the passing attack with the Ravens banged up at wideout. He played 55 percent of the offensive snaps, but Moore finished with one reception on three targets for six yards. There's a chance that Moore remains a starter for the Week 3 matchup against the Dallas Cowboys. If he's out, Devontez Walker could see an elevated role. It's unlikely that either player does enough in the receiving game to warrant rostering in fantasy formats right now.

metadata.title: Chris Moore (ankle) a limited participant Wednesday
metadata.description: Chris Moore (ankle) was a limited participant at practice on Wednesday.
metadata.analysis: The Ravens listed Moore as a limited participant on Wednesday due to an ankle injury that he's dealing with. If it leaves him sidelined this week, look for Devontez Walker to see more work as a result of his absence.

metadata.title: Chris Moore Lining Up With Starters Before Kickoff
metadata.description: Baltimore Ravens wide receiver Chris Moore was lining up with the starters during pregame warmups ahead of Sunday's game against the New Orleans Saints, according to Josh Tolentino. Moore was promoted to the 53-man roster earlier this week and could be headed for a larger role with Zay Flowers out and Ja'Kobi Lane on injured reserve. He caught his only target for 53 yards against Indianapolis last week. Rashod Bateman remains Baltimore's top healthy receiver, but Moore's work with the starters before kickoff is a good sign that he could see more offensive snaps against New Orleans.

metadata.title: Chris Moore Could See Larger Role in Week 2
metadata.description: Baltimore Ravens wide receiver Chris Moore could see a bigger role in the offense during the Week 2 matchup against the New Orleans Saints. The injury bug has bitten the Ravens hard over the last week. Rookie wideout Ja'Kobi Lane (wrist) was placed on the Injured Reserve, while Zay Flowers (hamstring) is doubtful to play on Sunday. The injuries to this roster could mean that Moore serves as the second or third receiver this weekend. He hauled in one of his two targets for 53 yards during the season opener. Fantasy managers should keep an eye on Moore as a possible deep league option.

metadata.title: Chris Moore - Signed to Ravens' active roster
metadata.description: Moore was signed to the Ravens' active roster Wednesday, Brian Wacker of The Baltimore Sun reports.
metadata.analysis: With Ja'Kobi Lane (wrist) now on the injured reserve list, Moore was signed to help fill the void. The 33-year-old has appeared in games for the Ravens, Texans, Titans and Commanders during his career. In 120 regular-season appearances, Moore garnered 149 catches (238 targets) for 1,917 yards and nine touchdowns, adding 17 carries for 78 yards and three touchdowns.

metadata.title: Chris Moore - Reverts to practice squad
metadata.description: Moore reverted to the practice squad with the Ravens on Monday, per the NFL's official transaction log.
metadata.analysis: Moore was elevated to the active roster ahead of Sunday's 41-23 win over the Colts, and he had an impressive day. The wide receiver played 25 of the team's 68 offensive snaps and 16 snaps on special teams, reeling in one of two targets for 52 yards while also adding 121 yards on four kick returns and a tackle on kick coverage. With Zay Flowers (hamstring), Ja'Kobi Lane (wrist) and Devontez Walker (groin) all banged up, there's a decent chance that Moore is elevated again in Week 2 versus the Saints.

metadata.title: Chris Moore catches one pass in Week 1
metadata.description: Chris Moore caught one of his two targets for 53 yards in the Ravens' 41-23 win over the Indianapolis Colts in Week 1.
metadata.analysis: Moore made up for an otherwise forgettable day with an explosive play in the Week 1 win. The veteran wideout could be in line for increased targets after both Zay Flowers (hamstring) and Ja'Kobi Lane (wrist) exited with injuries in the season opener, with a Week 2 contest against the New Orleans Saints up next.

metadata.title: Chris Moore - Elevated to active roster
metadata.description: The Ravens elevated Moore from the practice squad to the active roster Saturday.
metadata.analysis: With Devontez Walker (groin) listed as questionable for Sunday's game, Moore has a chance to suit up as a depth addition to the Ravens' wide receiver corps as the team takes on the Colts. Moore played in 14 regular-season games for the Commanders in 2025, catching 11 passes for 207 yards and a touchdown.

metadata.title: Chris Moore - Staying with Baltimore on practice squad
metadata.description: The Ravens signed Moore to the practice squad Monday, Ryan Mink of the team's official site reports.
metadata.analysis: Moore was unable to crack the Ravens' 53-man roster for the upcoming season, but he's opted to stick around on the practice squad of the team that selected him in the fourth round of the 2016 NFL Draft. Moore appeared in 14 regular-season games for the Commanders last year, finishing with 11 catches (on 23 targets) for 207 yards and a touchdown and 157 yards on six kickoff returns. He would be a candidate for elevation to the main roster should the Ravens require another pass catcher or contributor on special teams.
